scope: Independent source-only review of isolated Phase6 browser acceptance preparation

defects: Unknown glass-orb nested appearance ID exposed crystal_ball source identity.
Protected hallucinated native lock-pick output legitimately had a NULL semantic descriptor; the old test wrongly required a nested descriptor.

required_contracts.hallucinated_name: Exact original C public English message with upstream.untranslated history, no invented descriptor or entity identity.
required_contracts.normal_suite: Existing 18 stages, all 13 roles, desktop, fresh mobile touch startup, native save and fresh-instance map/state restore.
required_contracts.native_suite: 11 base stages including same-page native S/restore lifecycle; 3 optional Phase7 stages.
required_contracts.data_probe: Separate original-reader WASM bound to exact nhdat, target flags/headers/original functions and final engine manifest; never claim executable identity with the full engine.

findings.location: browser-host-phase6-name-producers.mjs: known lock-pick stage and pickNearPet
findings.finding: Known nested-name verified flags were set using a substring ID without stage.sourceOwner, allowing an unbound original source contract to receive a verified flag.
findings.requested_fix: Require exact nethack.message.lock.pick_lock.pline.i_don_t_think_s_would_appreciate.96869543af, API/callback/window and sourceOwner(original-call hash + compiled src/lock.c).

findings.finding: The two EN/JA DOM baselines were painted before state/history snapshots and call interception; a first-switch history/input/RNG mutation or lazy registration could be accepted as the new baseline.
findings.requested_fix: Snapshot before either preparatory paint, enforce registered-only export calls for both paints, compare owned/native/trace state after them, then execute the measured 100 transitions.

findings.location: browser-host-phase6-browser.mjs and browser-host-phase6-name-producers.mjs: test source provenance
findings.finding: The normal suite recorded no test-source hashes; the native suite hashed only itself and CDP, omitted stage/lifecycle/server dependencies, and did not end-rehash the instrumentation.
findings.requested_fix: Hash every actual suite and instrumentation dependency before launch, hash optional Phase7 dependencies, and verify unchanged source bytes before success.

findings.finding: Phase6 name fixtures had no wrong-window/wrong-callback test or actual-pair post-callback getter-expiry check. Optional Phase7 checks occur on a later replacement module.
findings.requested_fix: Add bounded test-only read-only mismatch and expiry probes outside rendering; preserve actual callback capture and NULL fallback behavior.

findings.finding: The sampler omitted messages/modal scroll offsets and active-element identity while describing scroll/focus preservation.
findings.requested_fix: Include messages/modal scroll offsets and focus identity in the repeated locale snapshots or narrow the claim.

findings.finding: Only config overwrite was refused. A new config could reuse an existing report directory and suites overwrite fixed verification/screenshot filenames, including an arbitrary historical build subtree.
findings.requested_fix: Reserve fresh per-suite report/artifact targets and protect historical runtime/report roots, while allowing the two serial suites to share one new acceptance root.

findings.location: browser-host-phase6-cdp.mjs: WebSocket connect and DevTools HTTP fetch
findings.finding: After DevToolsActivePort exists, HTTP fetch and WebSocket handshake can stall without a deadline; the startup loop deadline no longer applies, and the external monitor has no total timeout.
findings.requested_fix: Add bounded HTTP and handshake deadlines plus cleanup of the owned Chrome child on launch failure.

findings.finding: Seven canonical binding keys, report pass flags and disk nhdat bytes were checked, but the gate did not dereference prepared_sha256/source_evidence, compare candidate/generator references, target flags/shared headers/original functions/macros, hash separate probe artifacts, or bind emitted-engine embedded nhdat byte metadata.
findings.requested_fix: Bind and validate prepared.json and separate original-consumer artifacts; record exact per-unit full-engine compile flags and certified embedded nhdat WASM file-table name/length/content evidence plus emitted JS loader hashes; compare shared headers and original-reader provenance. Engine.data_files is a name list. Never require probe WASM SHA equality with the engine.

findings.location: browser-host-phase6-name-producers.mjs: stage.repaintInvariant and Phase7 scenarios assertPhase7RepaintInvariant
findings.finding: The Phase6 suite assigned a complete-DOM ten-batch repaint hook, but frozen Phase7 scenarios never invoked it. Optional stages retained narrower one-shot state/frame/draft checks.
findings.requested_fix: Route the frozen Phase7 owner through the shared hook and re-freeze, retaining getter probes, or keep the optional coverage claim explicitly narrower.

findings.location: browser-host-phase6-stage.mjs: duplicate metadata merge and sourceOwner
findings.finding: Duplicate contracts did not compare argument schema fields; generic sourceOwner did not validate captured operand unions; the Phase7 branch did not explicitly assert source membership in compiled inputs.
findings.requested_fix: Validate argument-key/type unions, allowing source-approved nested event refinement of original text; compare applicable duplicate schema fields and require compiled Phase7 owner source membership.

findings.finding: The new stale-getter probe asserted null for ccall string return. Current local Emscripten libccall converts the pointer using UTF8ToString, and libstrings returns empty string for pointer zero.
findings.requested_fix: Probe the numeric pointer and require exactly 0, or require empty string for the string conversion. The explicitly normalized nativeRows envelope null remains correct.

findings.finding: Nonempty text and retained history alone accept a caught gameplay formatter failure with semantic-unavailable English fallback, while claiming the owned ended-game catalogs render history.
findings.requested_fix: Compare previously verified exact EN/JA semantic name and protected English fallback rows/statuses after S, or narrow the claim to nonempty retained history.

findings.location: browser-host-phase6-browser.mjs native ID locale pair and native name/getlin expected locale paints
findings.finding: Extra EN/JA expected-row paints occur before the shared100 preparation guard, so their earliest locale switch can change history/state or perform a lazy call before the later measured baseline.
findings.requested_fix: Bracket these separate exact-row locale paints with registered-only calls and owned/native snapshots, like the revised Phase7 exact-frame pair. Do not add another100 loop.

findings.finding: The first guarded shared locale pair snapshotted history/frame/input queue and focus but not input, textarea or select values and carets. A first paint could erase an active getlin draft and the EN/JA DOM baselines would then accept the erased value.
findings.requested_fix: Snapshot all controls including value, checked, selectionStart and selectionEnd before the first preparation paint, compare after each paint and throughout all 100 transitions. Retain the earliest paintLocale draft guard.
findings.reported_by: Independent Phase7 owner source review, concurred by browser acceptance reviewer

confirmed_source_design: Normal suite does not install the CDP app lifecycle overlay; callback observation is explicit test instrumentation.
Native Fetch overlay targets one exact app URL, verifies original app hash and unique insertion anchor, records original/served bytes and SHA, and inserts before RustLayers registration.
Lifecycle observer forwards original this/arguments/return/throw with Reflect.apply and records metadata only.
The staged host disposes owned catalogs before calling the replacement module factory; ended history catalogs are retained until replacement.
Native fixture uses original -X, wishing, lookup, apply, drink and S commands; no -D, wizard-policy or game-field edits were found in the reviewed preparation.
Unknown glass-orb assertions require the exact public alias and exact nested field union; private ledger IDs remain offline source evidence.
Protected hallucinated naming accepts the exact original English fallback with NULL descriptor and no invented nested identity.
Measured loops retain current complete owned history, cached frame and input queue/consumption; no fixture history pruning was found. Product visible scrollback is bounded separately.
The README requires parent serial-slot permission and a fresh >=2 GiB physical AND commit headroom measurement with the owned process-tree monitor. Source preparation itself starts no runtime.

performance_scope.timing: End-to-end locale change, render, full-DOM/canvas/history checks in ten measured batches.
performance_scope.required_future_comparison: Use the same complete captured history/workload and exact EN/JA fallback outputs for baseline and registered renderers, observe both first locale paints, and keep native/RNG/input state unchanged.

remaining_runtime_gates: Final corrected full-engine build and exact manifest freeze.
New original-data-consumer proof and canonical seven-key binding.
Serial normal 18-stage browser execution and native 11+3 optional stage execution.
Complete same-history legacy/registered comparison before any speedup claim.
Encyclopedia original reader, full campaign, complete Japanese coverage, quest/a11y/impossible and five wizard-gated Phase7 branches remain unproved.
resource_gate_scope: Config and source preparation do not execute runtime. Loader requires explicit parent serial-slot env; a fresh >=2GiB physical AND commit headroom measurement is enforced by the separately documented owned process-tree monitor invocation, not inferred from config.
locale_transition_scope: Exactly100 measured transitions per stress loop in ten10 batches; the first guarded EN/JA baseline pair and exact source-frame expectation paints are outside100 and must be recorded separately. Complete retained owned history is compared; full visible DOM/canvas/fallback/draft/focus/scroll uses exact locale baselines.
final_data_schema_scope: Acceptance source now validates prepared raw archive lineage, separate probe artifact identity, exact shared flags/macros/headers/fixed original readers, unique successful full-engine unit source set, and manifest-declared actual embedded /nhdat table payload count/hash with emitted loader/artifact lineage. This reread does not execute the consumer or certify an unavailable future full-engine manifest.
